entry.content: • Promoted developer-knowledge commands to the beta track.
entry.summary: The developer-knowledge commands have been promoted to the beta track. This means they are now available for broader testing and feedback before a general availability release. Users can explore these features and contribute to their refinement.
entry.title: gcloud beta developer-knowledge: Developer knowledge commands now in beta

entry.content: • Added --tags flag to gcloud beta parametermanager parameters create to allow binding tags during parameter creation.
entry.summary: You can now bind tags to parameters when creating them using the `--tags` flag in `gcloud beta parametermanager parameters create`. This enhances parameter organization and management.
entry.title: Parametermanager: Tagging for Parameters

entry.content:
• Added gcloud policy-troubleshoot error-info-id to troubleshoot access denials using an IAM error identifier.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: You can now troubleshoot access denials more easily using the new `gcloud policy-troubleshoot error-info-id` command. This command leverages an IAM error identifier to help you diagnose and resolve permission issues.
entry.title: Policy Troubleshooter: Troubleshoot access denials with error info
